concept: Awwwards-level luxury nail salon marketing site. Aesthetic: Elegant pink, white, soft gold, airy spacing, subtle floral details, and luxury editorial feel.

headings.usage: Hero typography, section headers, numbered manifesto chapters. Use tracking-tighter.

body.usage: All paragraph text, buttons, and navigation. Clean geometric readability.

accent.usage: Used selectively for small labels, editorial callouts, and the Spanish EN/ES switcher.

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Bento Grid Protocol Mode A (Tetris) for Gallery. Asymmetrical layout for Services and Home manifesto. Use col-span-full md:col-span-8 to create tension.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Optical alignment. Left-aligned heavy typography with indented body copy for editorial feel.

motion.scrolling: Lenis for buttery smooth momentum scrolling. Mandatory for premium feel.
motion.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line typography reveal on load using framer-motion (initial Y offset 100%, animate to 0% with ease-[0.16,1,0.3,1]).
motion.parallax: Subtle parallax moment in the hero. Layer the logo, a soft pink floral texture in the background, and moving text to create depth on scroll via framer-motion.
motion.marquee: Slow editorial ribbon using react-fast-marquee. Text: 'MON REVE NAIL SPA • BEAUTY & LUXURY •' with low contrast pale gold bg and deep rose text.
motion.interactions: Hover states on all buttons: subtle scale up + glow. Image hover: slow scale-in 1.05 within hidden overflow container.

buttons.primary: Pill-shaped, bg-primary hover:bg-primary/90 text-primary_foreground, subtle shadow, text-sm uppercase tracking-widest.
buttons.secondary: Outline button, border-secondary text-text_primary hover:bg-secondary/10, pill-shaped.

header.style: Crystal Glassmorphism: sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border-b border-white/40.
header.elements: Logo center or left. EN/ES prominent switcher. 'Book Appointment' click-to-call button. Desktop links visible, hamburger only on mobile. MUST NOT use full transparent background.

cards.services: Cardless editorial layout. Clean lines (border-b border-border) connecting service name to price. No heavy drop shadows. High whitespace.

sections: Kinetic Hero: Large 'Mon Reve' text with signature masked reveal. Parallax floating abstract floral texture. Main CTA: 'Book via Phone (646-750-9932)'.
Manifesto Chapters: Numbered (01, 02, 03) large editorial text blocks highlighting the luxury experience, bilingual toggle affects content.
Gallery Teaser: Asymmetrical overlapping images with 'View All' link.

services.layout: Categorized lists with clean dotted or solid connecting lines to prices. High-quality contextual photos floating alongside specific categories.

gallery.structure: Responsive masonry or irregular bento grid.
gallery.features: Lightbox for full image view. Placeholder area marked 'Future Spa Photos' stylized elegantly so it looks intentional (e.g., solid blush pink block with delicate text and subtle border).

contact.layout: Split screen: Typography and Information on left, Map on right.
details: Address: 17171 Pines Blvd, Pembroke Pines, FL 33027 (Inside Sedano's, Kiosk #5)
Hours: Mon-Sat 10 AM - 8 PM, Sun 11 AM - 5 PM

hero_background.description: Abstract soft pink and white flowing shapes - use as subtle texture/parallax layer

pedicure_1.description: Luxury foot spa with floating flowers for Services (Pedicure section)

pedicure_2.description: Feet with flowers for Home page features

instructions_to_main_agent: Use framer-motion heavily for entrance animations. The hero MUST feature a line-by-line masked text reveal. Wrap text lines in hidden overflow containers and animate Y from 100% to 0.
Ensure language toggle (EN/ES) is prominent in the header and functional. Provide English copy by default but design it to handle switching.
Never use generic card layouts. Aim for an editorial, magazine-style bento grid with heavy padding and asymmetrical overlapping.
All CTA buttons should be click-to-call. Format: href='tel:6467509932'. NO online booking forms.
Use lucide-react or @phosphor-icons/react for minimalist luxury icons (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Map Pin, Phone).
Header must use Crystal Glassmorphism, not generic transparency.
For the future gallery placeholder, create a beautifully designed div with a soft background color, a delicate floral icon, and 'Coming Soon: Mon Reve Spa Interior'.
Apply fonts globally using Tailwind CSS classes properly configured in tailwind.config.js.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters.
DO NOT apply universal transition (transition: all).
DO NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
NEVER use emoji characters for icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
